note: Holdout set, writer B, written blind to toolset_tuning.json. Labels follow the policy below; follow-ups are labelled by the toolsets the follow-up job itself must call (a file to send that lives in Drive keeps drive). This set decides whether the router ships; do not tune against it.
policy:
TOOLSETS (multi-label; a message gets EVERY toolset its job needs, possibly none):
- calendar: the owner's own Google Calendar — events, classes/lectures, meetings, schedule, free time, creating/moving/deleting events, answering invites, "what's next", "my day".
- maps: places and getting around — a place's address or Google Maps link, directions, travel time, routes, traffic, places nearby (cafés, restaurants to visit), weather/forecast.
- gmail: the owner's own email — finding, reading, counting mail; what someone sent; receipts in mail. (Read only.)
- drive: the owner's Google Drive — finding/reading a doc, sheet, slides, PDF stored there; creating a doc there.
- github: the owner's GitHub — repos, issues, PRs, commits, branches, CI/build status.
- doordash: ordering food, groceries or retail delivery/pickup through DoorDash — finding what's open to order, menus, carts, placing/reordering/tracking an order, past orders.
- share: sending a file from the owner's Mac TO ANOTHER PERSON by iMessage or email ("send the deck to Ana"). Sending a file to the owner themself in this chat is NOT share.
- workspace: the owner's Slack, Notion or Linear (messages, channels, pages, tickets).
Not a toolset (label none of the above for these): general chat, web facts/news/opening hours of a business from the web, math, coding questions, memory ("what did I say about…"), controlling the Mac screen ("close my tabs"), lights/TV/music, reminders the assistant keeps itself, sending a file to the owner themself.
Compound jobs get several labels ("my next class and a maps link" -> calendar+maps; "email Ana the PDF from my drive" -> drive+share; "order lunch to my 2pm meeting's room" -> doordash+calendar).
